strategy.name: RSI + MACD Divergence (Regular & Hidden)
strategy.summary: Divergence on BOTH RSI(14) and the MACD histogram, plus a trigger, at a higher-timeframe zone.

rules.text: Divergence must appear on both RSI(14) and the MACD histogram. Regular: first RSI pivot > 70 (bear) / < 30 (bull).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the divergence on both RSI and MACD?

rules.text: Divergence alone is not an entry: wait for a micro-trendline break, LTF structure break, or MACD signal cross at an HTF zone.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you wait for a trigger?

rules.text: Stop 1 × ATR beyond the divergence swing.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop 1 × ATR beyond the swing?

rules.text: Counter-trend regular divergence only inside a 4H/Daily zone with an LTF structure break.
rules.checklistQuestion: For counter-trend trades, were you inside an HTF zone?
